lessons.title: Read rows with SELECT.
lessons.explain: SELECT picks columns, FROM picks the table, WHERE filters rows and ORDER BY sorts the result.
lessons.exercise: Select every student scoring under 50, lowest first.
lessons.code:
SELECT name, score
FROM students
WHERE score > 80
ORDER BY score DESC;

lessons.title: Add and change rows.
lessons.explain: INSERT adds rows, UPDATE changes them and DELETE removes them. Always add WHERE to UPDATE and DELETE.
lessons.exercise: Insert two students, then raise one score by 5.

lessons.title: Combine two tables.
lessons.explain: A JOIN lines up rows from two tables using a shared key. INNER keeps matches and LEFT keeps every left row.
lessons.exercise: List each course with its student count using a LEFT JOIN.

lessons.title: Count and average with GROUP BY.
lessons.explain: GROUP BY collapses rows into groups and aggregates like COUNT and AVG summarize each one. HAVING filters the groups.
lessons.exercise: Show courses whose average score is above 70.
lessons.solutionDiff:
SELECT course_id, AVG(score) AS avg
 FROM students
 GROUP BY course_id
+HAVING AVG(score) > 70;

capstone: A school database with students, courses and a grades report.
